comment: Keeps vampires away. Sadly, the horny bard remains completely immune.
A wizard turned his apprentice into a lemon. Nobody noticed until someone asked for seconds.
Zeus came for dinner. Nine months later, half the village could summon lightning.
The druid summoned a bear for honey. The bear ate the druid. Surprisingly good honey, though.
The merchant promised authentic royal cuisine. The palace wants its missing chef back.
The monks kept a vow of silence for six centuries. Then someone burned the fucking chicken.
A dragon called this too spicy. His wife has been telling everyone ever since.
Named after a pirate captain who slept with a sea witch. The curse was surprisingly accurate.
A bard wrote a love song about this chicken. His wife left him. The chicken filed a restraining order.
The druid insists every herb has feelings. Nobody has the heart to tell him about the salad.
The witch promised a night of unbearable heat. The barbarian misunderstood and arrived without trousers.
The elves spent 400 years sun-drying these tomatoes. The dwarf called them raisins and started a war.
The forest smells wonderful today. Either someone's cooking or the hag has found another husband.
The king demanded the secret ingredient. The chef said peanuts. Seventeen royal interrogators resigned.
A pirate traded his ship for this recipe. His crew made him walk the plank. Fair enough.
The dragon offered to smoke the chicken. Three hours later, he was discussing philosophy with a potato.
A dwarf married a wheel of cheese. The marriage ended when he discovered she was seeing a grater.
The barbarian demanded more heat. He's now naked in the village fountain, screaming at the gods.
A mermaid offered this recipe in exchange for a sailor's firstborn. He asked if she'd take his mother-in-law.
The farmer's cows have started speaking Infernal. The milk is excellent, so nobody's asking questions.
